This notice identifies the sources used in the Countries States Cities Database (CSC), their licences,
required credits and CSC’s changes. Keep this notice and the accompanying licence notices with all copies of
the data and pass them to recipients. Preserve the credits, licence links and change notices when reusing the
data; each linked licence sets the full terms of reuse.

1. Postal Areas 2021 and Mesh Block allocation
Publisher: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS)
Edition: ASGS Edition 3, July 2021
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Credit: Based on Australian Bureau of Statistics data, ASGS Edition 3, Postal Areas 2021 and Mesh Block
allocation. © Commonwealth of Australia. CC BY 4.0.
Source:
https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs/edition-3-july-2021-june-2026/non-abs-structures/postal-areas
Changes by CSC: CSC selected one record per postcode and mapped state membership, removing earlier locality
names and points.
Reuse: Credit the source, retain the licence link and supplied notices, and identify changes; do not imply
endorsement.

2. CACLR national register of localities and streets
Publisher: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie (ACT), Luxembourg
Edition: edition not recorded; checked 12 October 2026
Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Credit: Source: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie (ACT), Luxembourg, CACLR national register of
localities and streets, edition not recorded; checked 12 October 2026.
Source:
https://data.public.lu/api/1/datasets/registre-national-des-localites-et-des-rues/
Changes by CSC: CSC selected postcode, locality and canton combinations, mapped cantons to its regions and
omitted unassigned postcodes.
Reuse: CC0 imposes no attribution requirement.

3. CartoCiudad postal addresses (portalpk_publi)
Publisher: Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN) / Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG), Spain
Edition: April 2026, 52 province files
Licence: IGN product licence (CC BY 4.0 compatible)
https://www.ign.es/resources/licencia/Condiciones_licenciaUso_IGN.pdf
Credit: Obra derivada de CartoCiudad 04/2026 CC-BY 4.0 scne.es/productos.html#CartoCiudad
Source:
https://centrodedescargas.cnig.es/CentroDescargas/cartociudad
Changes by CSC: CSC selected distinct postcodes, assigned provinces and municipalities where addresses agreed,
averaged address coordinates and withheld 26 invalid averages.
Reuse: Retain this derivative credit visibly with the data and in any dataset or service metadata; identify
further changes.

4. Australian postal code dump

Changes by CSC: CSC selected postcode values from the Australian postal code dump and matched them to its
records.
Reuse: Credit the source, retain the licence link and supplied notices, and identify changes; do not imply
endorsement.

5. All India Pincode Directory
Publisher: Department of Posts, India; Open Government Data Platform India

India. https://data.gov.in/catalog/all-india-pincode-directory. Published under Government Open Data License
India: https://data.gov.in/government-open-data-license-india.
Source:
https://data.gov.in/catalog/all-india-pincode-directory
Changes by CSC: CSC selected a representative post office for each postcode, mapped administrative fields and
added its identifiers.
Reuse: Acknowledge the provider, source and licence using GODL section 5 or an accepted data citation; do not
imply endorsement.

7. Base officielle des codes postaux
Publisher: La Poste
Edition: last update of the imported snapshot not recovered; checked by CSC 13 October 2026
Licence: Licence Ouverte 2.0
https://github.com/etalab/licence-ouverte/blob/master/LO.md
Credit: Source: La Poste, Base officielle des codes postaux; last update of the imported snapshot not
recovered (CSC check: 13 October 2026).
Open condition: Licence Ouverte asks for the date of the last update of the reused information. The date of
the snapshot CSC imported has not been recovered; this notice does not complete that condition.
Source:
https://www.data.gouv.fr/fr/datasets/base-officielle-des-codes-postaux/
Changes by CSC: CSC selected postcode and locality values, matched them to its records and adapted their
structure.
Reuse: Retain the source and the date of the last update of the reused information; do not mislead recipients
about its content, source or update date.

10. Postal Code File (PCF)
Publisher: Posti
Edition: imported edition not recorded; scope-check file dated 8 October 2026
Licence: Posti Postal Code Services terms, effective 1 January 2015
https://www.posti.fi/en/for-businesses/customer-support/postal-code-services
Credit: Source: Posti, Postal Code File (PCF); imported edition not recorded; scope-check file dated 8 October
2026.
Source:
https://www.posti.fi/webpcode/
Changes by CSC: CSC selected postcode and name values and mapped regional membership.
PCF scope-check download: 8 October 2026. The download date of the material first imported has not been
recovered.
Open condition: Posti's terms require the download date of the material to be passed to recipients; this
notice does not complete that condition for the imported PCF values.
The terms are in Posti-postal-code-terms.txt in the repository, attached to export releases as
NOTICE-Posti-postal-code-terms.txt.
Reuse: Pass the current service description, terms of use and data download date to every recipient.
